result.label: venomvine thicket
result.description: The shrubland lineage of the venomvine, and the only thing on this plain that grows in a mass. Where the desert form scatters, this one closes: runner over runner over runner until the tangle is chest-high, matted into itself, and lightless inside. Its thorns carry the same sap. A womprat runs the tangle at speed and a person can force a way in if they are patient and do not mind bleeding; nothing bigger gets past the first arm's length of it. The settlements plant it instead of building walls.

result.label: vissler arm
result.description: The shed arm of a vissler: a curled, jointed whip of lichen-grey plates, the ember glow at its joints fading toward the broken end. It keeps twitching for a while after it is cut. Hunters buy them.
